verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents versioning and review for agents: you register a new agent version and compare it against the previous one on the same tasks [10][2][12]. Task suites [13] and environments [15] are frozen into pinned versions, and the recorded actions behind each score can be inspected [2][14]. Rollback rests on a single marketing line about 'autonomous fix and rollback' of production agents [24], and the versioning serves evaluation rather than managing the automations themselves. Missing for 10: documented rollback mechanics or workflow, versioning of workflow automations as such (not just agents under test), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
